checkpoints.description: [1/2] Persist the best-run ghost trace in the record file so the ghost survives a relaunch, with a bounded, rounded representation and backward-compatible loading; LiveGame saves/restores it; [2/2] failing-first tests plus README update.

impact_assessment.why: Best times, splits, near stats and streaks persist, but the ghost trace is session-only, so the visual comparison vanishes on relaunch.
impact_assessment.benefits: The ghost becomes a durable reward consistent with the other persisted bests.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: Records gains a traces field plus load_traces and a finish_run argument; JSON size; concurrency: same lock; state: capped samples, rounded values, invalid data quarantines
impact_assessment.mitigation: Tests for round-trip, old-file default, cap, invalid values and LiveGame restore; check file stays under the decode limit; run all 5 project gates.

checkpoints.description: Overlay the best-run ghost's current distance as a marker on the HUD course minimap, derived from the best trace and elapsed time; distinct from the boulder/checkpoint/pickup markers; no simulation change.

impact_assessment.why: The minimap shows the car and upcoming obstacles but not where the best-run ghost is, so the spatial comparison is missing from that view.
impact_assessment.benefits: Reuses the best trace and minimap; no new state or engine change.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: adds a ghost marker char to minimap rows; dependency: best_traces/ghost_state; concurrency: none; state: derived from elapsed/distance
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing tests for ghost marker presence when ahead/behind and absence without a trace; run all 5 project gates.

checkpoints.description: Minimap ghost marker: the best-run ghost's distance (interpolated by elapsed) shows as G on the HUD course strip when ahead; 246 tests pass, demo verified G at 30m and absence at 10m, all 5 gates pass. Left uncommitted (no commit authorization).
Add an in-world speedometer: a row of glowing bars on the car lights up proportionally to current speed, using a fixed node pool and frozen-material swaps, cleared/updated by speed each frame.

impact_assessment.why: Speed is only a HUD number; a visible gauge on the car gives a diegetic sense of acceleration.
impact_assessment.benefits: Reuses fixed node pool and material-swap patterns; no simulation or storage change.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: adds a constant, a node pool and a material; dependency: frozen Transform/Material; concurrency: none; state: derived from speed each frame
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing tests for bar count, lit proportion with speed, no bars at rest and reset behavior; run all 5 project gates.

checkpoints.description: In-world speedometer: 8 glowing bars on the car light proportionally to speed (0/2/4/8 at 0/7.5/15/30 m/s), using a scene node pool and material swaps; 248 tests pass, all 5 project gates pass. Left uncommitted (no commit authorization).

Add a proximity warning: when the next boulder is within a short distance and the car's lateral gap is within the near-miss band, show a TOO CLOSE HUD hint derived from the crossing geometry; no simulation change.

impact_assessment.why: The near-miss mechanic rewards close passes but gives no live warning while approaching one, so the player only learns after the crossing.
impact_assessment.benefits: Derived from course_rocks and lateral position; reuses NEAR_MISS_GAP; no state or storage.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: adds one helper and one HUD label; dependency: course_rocks/NEAR_MISS_GAP; concurrency: none; state: read-only
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing tests for hint when close, absent when far/wide, and HUD presence; run all 5 project gates.

checkpoints.description: Proximity warning: TOO CLOSE HUD hint when the next boulder is within 20m and the car's lateral gap is inside the near-miss band; 251 tests pass, demo verified close/far/wide cases, all 5 project gates pass. Left uncommitted (no commit authorization).
Add a remaining-time bar to the HUD: an ASCII gauge filled proportionally to remaining / START_TIME, shown while racing and derived from existing state.

impact_assessment.why: The numeric timer requires reading to judge how much time is left; a shrinking bar gives an instant visual sense of the budget.
impact_assessment.benefits: Derived from remaining and START_TIME; no simulation or storage change.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: adds one helper and one HUD label; dependency: START_TIME; concurrency: none; state: read-only
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing tests for full/empty/partial bar and HUD presence; run all 5 project gates.

checkpoints.description: Remaining-time bar: HUD shows a 20-cell ASCII gauge shrinking with remaining / START_TIME; 253 tests pass, demo verified full/half/near-empty/empty bars, all 5 project gates pass. Left uncommitted (no commit authorization).
Add a checkpoint countdown to the HUD: show how many checkpoints remain (e.g. '2 LEFT'), derived from the checkpoint count; replace the raw count display with a clearer remaining view.

impact_assessment.why: The HUD shows 'CHECKPOINT n/3' which requires mental subtraction to know how many remain; a direct countdown is clearer.
impact_assessment.benefits: Derived from the checkpoint count; no simulation or storage change.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: adds one helper and adjusts one HUD label; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: read-only
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing tests for remaining count at each checkpoint and HUD text; run all 5 project gates.

checkpoints.description: Checkpoint countdown: HUD shows CHECKPOINTS n LEFT derived from checkpoint count; 255 tests pass, demo verified 3/2/1/0, all 5 project gates pass. Left uncommitted (no commit authorization).
Persist a per-course best-finish count in records, restored by LiveGame and shown on the ready screen, distinct from lifetime finishes and golds.

impact_assessment.why: The record file tracks finishes and golds but not how many times a player has completed each specific course.
impact_assessment.benefits: Reuses the atomic finish_run writer and Records dataclass.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: Records gains a finishes map plus RunResult is always a finish; JSON keys numeric; concurrency: same lock; state: monotonic
impact_assessment.mitigation: Tests for old-file default, per-course accumulation, invalid values and LiveGame restore; run all 5 project gates.

checkpoints.description: Re-plan: per-course finish counts already exist via totals; instead persist a bounded run history (last N finishes with course, time, medal) restored by LiveGame, distinct from the single last_sessions record.

impact_assessment.why: last_sessions keeps only the most recent run per course; a short cross-course history gives players a reviewable log of recent finishes.
impact_assessment.benefits: Reuses the atomic finish_run writer; bounded list avoids unbounded growth.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: Records gains a history field plus RunResult use; JSON validation; concurrency: same lock; state: capped list
impact_assessment.mitigation: Tests for cap, ordering, old-file default, invalid values and LiveGame restore; run all 5 project gates.

checkpoints.description: Run history: persist a capped 5-entry cross-course finish log, restored by LiveGame with a ready-screen display of the last 3; fixed a frozen-dataclass cap bug via in-place deletion; 259 tests pass, all 5 project gates pass. Left uncommitted (no commit authorization).
Add a HUD readout of remaining boost pickups: show 'N PICKUPS LEFT' derived from PICKUP_STATIONS length minus pickups_collected, while racing.

impact_assessment.why: Players cannot see how many boost pickups remain ahead, so they may miss a chance to refill before the finish.
impact_assessment.benefits: Derived from existing pickup state; no simulation or storage change.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: adds one helper and one HUD label; dependency: PICKUP_STATIONS/pickups_collected; concurrency: none; state: read-only
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing tests for remaining count at each pickup and HUD presence; run all 5 project gates.

checkpoints.description: Pickup readout: HUD shows N PICKUPS LEFT derived from PICKUP_STATIONS minus pickups_collected, hidden when none remain; 261 tests pass, demo verified 3/2/1/0, all 5 project gates pass. Left uncommitted (no commit authorization).
